 The market research company Compas released a list of the best-selling Indonesian sunscreen brands on Shopee during the second quarter of 2026.
 This finding is based on online crawling results, which involve collecting product sales data digitally from official and non-official stores on Shopee, with a product rating criterion above 4 stars.
 As a result, the brand from PT Paragon Technology and Innovation (ParagonCorp), Wardah, secured the highest market share during that period.
 "In the Indonesian sunscreen category on Shopee in the second quarter of 2026, Wardah still consistently leads with a 10.43% market share," Compas wrote on its official Instagram account on Saturday (24/10/2026).
 Its closest rival, Facetology, achieved a 7.61% share of the total sunscreen sales value on Shopee. Meanwhile, other brands have a market share of less than 6.5%.
 Here is the list of the 10 best-selling Indonesian sunscreen brands on Shopee Indonesia in the second quarter of 2026, based on Compas' research
 Wardah: 10.43%
 Facetology: 7.61%
 Azarine: 6.25%
 Scora: 3.5%
 Emina: 2.47%
 Labore: 2.44%
 Hansui: 2.03%
 Ameterasun: 1.97%
 Oh My Glow (OMG): 1.87%
 Gloow&Be: 1.49%
